verdict.rationale: Goodwin documents a dedicated Data, Privacy & Cybersecurity practice that it describes as top-ranked and one of the longest-standing of any Am Law 50 firm, with specialists across the United States and Europe. That matches the story's requirement of a documented privacy/cyber practice. The single citation does not explicitly name GDPR, CCPA, DPDP or describe compliance counseling services, so coverage of specific regimes is only implied by the US/Europe footprint. Missing for 10: explicit mention of GDPR/CCPA/DPDP or equivalent compliance counseling, a description of the practice's services, and independent corroboration of the 'top-ranked' claim.
